title: T1565.002 — Data Manipulation - Transmitted Data Manipulation
subtitle: Watch "Transfer tampered on the wire": a customer on café Wi-Fi, an attacker who poisons ARP and rewrites a payment, and the bank controls that flag the mismatch.
aria: T1565.002 - Data Manipulation - Transmitted Data Manipulation

steps.title: Café Wi-Fi
steps.caption: The customer connects a managed work laptop to the café Wi-Fi. The attacker sits on the same guest network with a small laptop and scans it. Open guest networks have no port control, so any device can join
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
